description: We are Team Pleiades7 from Bangladesh, a team of passionate innovators exploring the intersection of astronomy, technology, and creativity. Through Cosmic Detective, we aim to transform real astronomical data into an engaging, story-driven multiplayer experience, making space exploration more accessible and inspiring collaborative discoveries through citizen science.
summary: Cosmic Detective transforms complex astronomical datasets into an accessible, story-driven multiplayer citizen-science experience. Players begin with guided training missions, learning astronomical investigation through interactive challenges before unlocking the Open Sky Research Portal to explore real NASA/SPHEREx observations across 102 near-infrared bands. They can compare observations, investigate unusual objects, and use specialized tools to examine astronomical data. Our project addresses the challenge of making complex astronomical research more accessible to people without prior scientific experience by combining storytelling, gamification, and collaboration. Moving forward, we aim to expand our investigation tools, introduce more collaborative research missions, and strengthen scientific validation workflows, while developing the multiplayer ranking system so experienced players can lead teams, assign investigations, and review findings. Ultimately, we want to build a community of citizen scientists who can contribute to real astronomical research.
details:
Cosmic Detective is a story-driven, online multiplayer citizen-science game that transforms astronomical exploration into an interactive investigation experience.

Players join a fictional cosmic detective organization and progress through five chapters containing 50 investigation cases. Through guided missions, they learn to explore astronomical images, compare observations across different epochs, identify unusual objects, and use specialized tools such as blink comparators, difference imaging, multi-band compositors, and light curve analyzers.

As players complete missions, they earn experience points, badges, and ranks, gradually unlocking advanced tools and responsibilities. They can also establish research squads, assign investigation tasks, and review findings collaboratively.

Beyond the training campaign, the Open Sky Research Portal connects to NASA/IPAC's Infrared Science Archive (IRSA), allowing users to search and visually investigate authentic SPHEREx observations using sky coordinates and 102 near-infrared bands.

Technology and Development:

The platform was developed using React 19, Vite 6, TypeScript, and CSS for the frontend, with Supabase and PostgreSQL supporting backend services, authentication, and database management. Netlify and Netlify Functions handle hosting and serverless operations, while a Python worker supports astronomical image processing. HTML Canvas 2D, SVG, and Web Audio API provide interactive visualization and user experiences.

The project incorporates astronomical resources including NASA SkyView, DSS, 2MASS, WISE, and NASA/IPAC IRSA for accessing observational data.

Creativity and Innovation:

The creativity of Cosmic Detective lies in combining storytelling, gamification, astronomical visualization, and multiplayer collaboration. Instead of simply presenting astronomical images, it transforms observations into investigative cases. Players develop their skills through missions, unlock advanced tools, and progress from trainees to research squad leaders.

A structured candidate-verification workflow further encourages evidence-based investigation by checking potential findings before they are considered promising candidates for further scientific examination.

Benefits and Intended Impact:

Cosmic Detective aims to bridge the gap between public curiosity and professional astronomical research. It makes astronomy more accessible to beginners while introducing them to authentic datasets, analytical tools, and scientific investigation methods.

Beyond education, the platform encourages analytical thinking, teamwork, and collaborative problem-solving. By creating opportunities for people with different levels of experience to participate in astronomical exploration, we hope to transform passive viewers into active citizen-science participants.

Throughout development, our team prioritized scientific authenticity, accessibility, progressive learning, user engagement, collaboration, and the reliability of potential findings. We also distinguished simulated training activities from investigations involving real astronomical observations.

Our vision is to turn curiosity into participation, learning into investigation, and collaboration into opportunities for scientific discovery.

"Every sky has a secret. Can you find it?"

Source code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/YeadMuhammad/Cosmic-Detective
